column3: MT 21:7. NASB follows the Hebrew “sanctuaries”; some manuscripts read “their sanctuary.”
MT 21:9. “I have cut off” is rendered “I shall cut off.”
MT 21:11. “Breaking of loins” is rendered “breaking heart.”
MT 21:15. The second half (“Or shall we rejoice, the rod of My son despising every tree?”) is very difficult; the meaning is uncertain.
MT 21:17. “Princes” is rendered “officials,” and “strike on the thigh” is part of the verse.
MT 21:18. The Hebrew is very difficult; the meaning is uncertain.
MT 21:19. “Strike palm to palm” is rendered “clap your hands together.”
MT 21:20. “Slaughter of a sword” is rendered “the glittering sword”; the word is uncertain.
MT 21:22. “Strike my palm” is rendered “clap My hands.”
MT 21:26. “Mother of the road” is rendered “parting of the way,” and “teraphim” is rendered “household idols.”
MT 21:31. “This not this” is rendered “this will be no more the same.”
MT 21:34. “Profaned of wicked” is rendered “the wicked who are slain.”
